coverage: Every in-service Canadian geographic area code; shared 867 coverage across Yukon, Northwest Territories and Nunavut, and 782/902 across Nova Scotia and Prince Edward Island. Canadian non-geographic services are listed without polygons; assigned future codes are listed separately.
geometry: Generalized public-domain UCLA 2015 reference footprints, clipped to the atlas Canadian province land. Whole-province and multi-province codes use the current atlas land directly. Regional reference polygons are simplified together to retain shared edges, including both Alberta regions and British Columbia regions. Coastal partitions are rebuilt from those shared dividing lines and current provincial land rings, discarding the old stepped coastal envelopes; islands missing from the old envelope inherit the nearest reference area. Dividing strokes come from those shared reference edges, are clipped to current provincial land, and omit province-wide overlays and obsolete reference perimeter fragments. Current overlays use their documented coverage, including province-wide BC and Alberta overlays and Toronto 942. These are reference areas, not address-level telephone-service guarantees; small later exchange boundary adjustments may not be reflected.
